title: Shattered Arcana — Phase 7 Sprint Report (2026-04-07)
content:
Phase 7 Sprint completed 2026-04-07.

SUBSYSTEMS BUILT:
- CoMDiplomacySubsystem: Relations, treaties, reputation (-1000 to +1000), war declarations with casus belli, mutual defense cascades, AI personality-driven diplomacy (aggressiveness, trustworthiness, cunning, forgiveness), war weariness, vassal system, gift system with diminishing returns.
- CoMEspionageSubsystem: Spy agents with skill/XP/leveling, 8 mission types (spy, sabotage, steal tech, assassinate, infiltrate, counterspy, propaganda, incite rebellion), counterintelligence, captured agent handling, double agents.
- CoMMagicSubsystem: Mana economy with nodes, spell casting (instant + multi-turn), spell research with allocation, rituals (multi-turn powerful effects), rune inscription, global enchantments with maintenance, dispelling, counter-magic.
- CoMSubsystemBridge: Cross-subsystem event wiring (spy caught → reputation penalty, tech stolen → spell learned, propaganda → reputation shift).
- CoMDragonSubsystem: Split from HeroSubsystem (SOLID). Dragon spawning, domains, eggs, hatching.

BUG FIXES (13):
- 2 crash bugs: use-after-free in Espionage, TMap iterator invalidation in Diplomacy
- 2 compilation blockers: broken includes, RemoveRune no-op
- 9 logic bugs: AcceptTreaty, ResearchSpend, mana underflow, SpawnUnit, CountHeroesOfTier, dragon domain, CounterSpy, gift tracking, FRandomStream

REFACTORING:
- Hero/Dragon subsystem split (Single Responsibility)
- CoMMapUtils.h (shared WrapX, DRY)
- CoMConstants.h (49 named constants)
- FRandomStream migration (deterministic RNG)

TEST SUITE: 65 tests across 10 files (4,000+ lines)

ART ASSETS GENERATED:
- 160 terrain tilesets (20 types x 8 planes)
- 123 icons (map features, buildings, spells)
- 126 unit sprites (42 races x 3 types)
- 26 hero portraits
- 600 spell catalogue designed (CoM/Warlord/D&D/Pathfinder inspired)
- 600 spell icons generating

Total project: 115+ source files, 28,000+ lines, ~971 art assets
